thinking: Examining the proposed `.sam_segment_boxes` function, it appears to chain several image processing operations. These include pre-processing, running an instance segmentation algorithm, resizing, filling holes, and applying morphological operations like median filtering, erosion, and dilation. The intent is likely to refine the segmentation masks generated by the instance segmentation model.

args.Description: Add .sam_segment_boxes helper to segment bounding boxes using Meta SAM 2.1
